(Japanese: '''セキエイこうげん''' ''{{tt|Sekiei Plateau|Indigo Plateau}}'') is the ninth and final chapter of the [[Pokémon Zensho]] manga.

==Plot==
The chapter starts with {{Zensho|Satoshi}} asleep at home. His mother calls for him to wake up. Since Satoshi ignores this, his {{p|Charizard}} grabs his hair with its tail, waking him up. As he goes downstairs he talks with his mother and then gets ready to leave. Then his {{p|Lapras}} starts to talk to Satoshi about the Elite Four. But when Pikachu hears how Satoshi wants to win against the Elite Four, Pikachu goes over to Satoshi's [[bag|backpack]] and grabs his [[Thunder Stone|Thunderstone]]. Satoshi turns around and sees this. Pikachu then uses the Thunderstone on itself and evolves into {{p|Raichu}}. Satoshi is happy that {{p|Pikachu}} has evolved and hugs his newly evolved Raichu. 

Then Satoshi gets on his Charizard, says goodbye to his mother, and then flies to the Indigo Plateau. When he arrives, he has his Badges checked and begins his first match with [[Lorelei]]. Lorelei sends out {{TP|Lorelei|Cloyster}} but when Satoshi sends out Raichu, it is easily beat. After he has beaten Lorelei he now battles against [[Bruno]]. Bruno sends out {{p|Hitmonlee}}, but it is easily defeated when Lapras quickly freezes it. His next battle is against [[Agatha]]. She sends out {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}} while Satoshi sends out his {{p|Alakazam}}. As her {{p|Gengar}} is easily defeated, it is time to battle against [[Lance]] who sends out his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Satoshi sends out his Charizard which hits it with a fire attack while the {{p|Dragonite}} uses a laser-type attack. Charizard attacks the Dragonite once again and it is defeated.

Just as Satoshi thinks he is the champion, it is revealed he has yet another opponent, {{Zensho|Shigeru}}. He tells Satoshi that he is the real champion, and he begins the battle. The battle starts with Shigeru sending out {{p|Blastoise}} while Satoshi sends out Charizard. Blastoise uses a {{type|Water}} attack, but Charizard hides behind one of the pillars to avoid it, which causes the pillar to crack. Then Charizard slams against Blastoise, which cause it to faint. With the battle won, Satoshi is now declared the new champion, and he thanks all his Pokémon for all the hard work they have done while Shigeru drops his [[Pokédex]]. Just then, [[Professor Oak]] and Shigeru's sister show up. He begins to compare the both boys' Pokédexes. Suddenly, the cracked pillar starts to crumble, and it falls right towards Shigeru but Satoshi leaps and pushes him out of the way. Afterwards, Shigeru accepts Satoshi as a friend. 

Prof. Oak then tells the boys of the [[Cerulean Cave|cave]] near [[Cerulean City]]. He explains how there are lots of rare Pokémon and a great place to fill their Pokédexes, and it is also where the extremely rare Pokémon {{p|Mewtwo}} can be found. Prof. Oak shows them a picture of it, and both boys decide that they will work together to catch it.

==Major events==
* {{Zensho|Satoshi}}'s {{p|Pikachu}} uses Satoshi's [[Thunder Stone|Thunderstone]] to [[Evolution|evolve]] itself into {{p|Raichu}}.
* Satoshi arrives at the [[Indigo Plateau]] and defeats the [[Elite Four]].
* Satoshi is revealed to have obtained an {{p|Alakazam}}.
* Satoshi finds out that {{Zensho|Shigeru}} has become the {{pkmn|Champion}}.
* Shigeru's {{p|Wartortle}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Blastoise}}.
* Satoshi defeats Shigeru, making him the new Pokémon League Champion.
* Satoshi and Shigeru team up to find and capture {{p|Mewtwo}}.
